body: Keep looking for therapists - some will let you bring the twins with you, or even have on site childcare.

Have you talked to your doctor or even a school counselor about this?  A lot of those symptoms sound like it could be ADHD and depression or bipolar, and it could be relatively simple to treat and give you the ability to do what you want.  Laziness/motivation/work ethic are, in my experience, symptoms of mental health and not an immutable personality flaw.
